## Why

Link the flag or issue and state the problem it solves.

## What changed

A short list.

## Evidence

Commands, test results, or a link to the verification. For a documentation change, name the files you read and the check you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request links one flag or issue.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated the documentation.
- [ ] I did not include confidential third-party material, API keys, or guest data.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] This pull request adds no dependency, or the description justifies each one (see docs/collaboration-security.md).
- [ ] This pull request adds no external URL, badge, tracker or remote script.
- [ ] If it touches a sensitive path (docs/collaboration-security.md, section 5), the description names which ones.
- [ ] Agent-authored: an AI agent wrote this pull request.
